agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime are zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only under v2.1 and must not become verified Experience, P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality or Governance evidence.

v2.1 strict-bool checks for secretary_signal_fresh, authority_conflict and direct event_independently_verified are valid local hardening, but do not establish provenance, freshness or verifier authority.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only; keeping it observational is acceptable until independently derived and adversarially validated.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly labels speedup as NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED and pressure as an engineering heuristic.
formal_mutation_allowed remains false and P_base remains read-only.

disagreements.finding: New this run: v1 explicitly supports N standby and R rollback. v2 inherits those selected_gear values, but v2.1 unconditionally executes int(selected[1:]). When inherited.selected_gear is N or R, selected[1:] is empty and v2.1 can raise ValueError on canonical standby/rollback safety paths. Existing v2.1 tests do not cover standby=True or rollback_required=True.
disagreements.required_change: Handle N/R as explicit terminal control states before any G-gear numeric parsing. N and R must bypass anti-thrash numeric comparison, preserve zero Experience/operational credit unless an independently accepted event receipt exists, and preserve inherited safety semantics. Add exact standby/rollback tests including high shift-rate input.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2 rounds pressure to 4 decimal places before comparing against 0.45 and 0.70; routing can therefore change because of presentation quantization rather than a raw-score gate crossing.
disagreements.required_change: Use unrounded canonical pressure for routing and round only a separate presentation field; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: The additive pressure heuristic can double count multiple telemetry fields that are downstream symptoms of the same latent incident.
disagreements.required_change: Bind source/incident lineage and use a versioned correlation or cluster-cap policy; do not treat weighted components as independent evidence.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller declarations even though their types are strict bools; no replay-resistant source, timestamp/TTL, policy or installation/runtime binding exists.
disagreements.required_change: Use typed SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope bound to exact source, scope, freshness, policy and runtime/install identity.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only disables secretary_level; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Consume an exact trusted authority decision/snapshot; missing, stale, revoked, cross-mission or cross-install authority evidence must fail closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum support, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce apparent gear_shift_rate while delaying necessary safe upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure throughput or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still requires only an event kind plus a boolean; exact evidence hash, verifier identity and trusted C/independent-verifier receipt are not required.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity plus a trusted verifier receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only within one aggregate invocation; same evidence under new IDs, cross-run/restart/rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Both credit classes must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline protocol establishes speedup; commit count, wake count or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen denominator/exposure/censoring/order, full assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Canonical N/R safety paths are currently untested in v2.1 and can fail before any performance statistic is meaningful.
Routing thresholds can be crossed by pressure rounding rather than a true raw-score crossing.
Correlated pressure telemetry can double count one latent incident.
Caller-declared freshness, authority conflict, current gear or verification stage invalidates causal routing comparisons.
Small-n shift-rate estimates have extreme variance and can false-trigger or chatter around a single threshold.
Anti-thrash can improve gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle/closure/recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later wired from policy-created progress back into upshift decisions.
Transient event identity plus direct decision-path credit can inflate longitudinal verified/operational totals.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.

durable_progress_per_wake is denominator-sensitive; verified_closure_per_hour is exposure/censoring-sensitive; fixed treatment order and completed-only analysis create carryover and survivorship bias.
proposed_tests: GB21-NR-STATE-069: standby=True with otherwise permissive inputs must deterministically return N without ValueError, anti-thrash parsing or formal mutation.
GB21-ROLLBACK-STATE-070: rollback_required=True with recent_shift_rate_ratio=1.0 must deterministically return R; anti-thrash must never delay rollback.
GB21-NR-CREDIT-INVARIANCE-071: N/R control-state selection alone creates zero verified Experience and zero operational progress unless a separate immutable accepted event receipt is present.
GB21-PRESSURE-ROUNDING-BOUNDARY-067 + PRESSURE-MONOTONIC-068: routing follows unrounded canonical pressure, never display rounding.

GB21-PRESSURE-CORRELATED-CAUSE-065 + PRESSURE-INDEPENDENT-CAUSE-066: redundant representation of one incident must not count as multiple independent warnings; truly independent bound sources may contribute under a versioned policy.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery must project G1 even when fallback caller kwargs are permissive.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift ledger, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded release are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is tied to one immutable accepted receipt.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen denominator/exposure policy, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.
release_condition: No formal adoption or speedup claim from this research review alone.
N and R control states must be explicitly supported by v2.1 before any G-gear numeric parsing; standby and rollback must never crash or be delayed by anti-thrash.
Pressure routing must use unrounded canonical values; any rounded value is presentation-only, with a versioned numeric policy and boundary tests.
Secretary and pressure telemetry freshness/provenance must be evidence-bound; fresh authority must be projected from an exact trusted decision, not a caller boolean.
Anti-thrash inputs must be canonically derived with adequate sample support, uncertainty and hysteretic release; cycle/closure/recovery performance must be non-inferior.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and tested against feedback/self-reinforcement.
All verified Experience requires exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt; DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only.
Experience/operational credit must be exactly-once and lineage-bound across restart/rollback/poll/replay; decision paths consume immutable acceptance receipts only.
5/4/3/1 weights remain heuristic and cannot be capability/Trust/Identity/Personality/promotion truth.

Any speedup claim requires a sealed matched-workload paired/crossover baseline over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen denominator/exposure/censoring/order, ITT workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

Existing verified Gearbox v1 and Step009 baselines remain preserved; P_base read-only; heartbeat/poll/retry/window age are not Experience; real_5min_runtime_live remains false until real authorized evidence exists.
